ModMetaData.name: ModularArmor
ModMetaData.author: Dreamer
ModMetaData.description:
Build armor to suit your needs.
Modular Armor adds customizable equipment to RimWorld. Install modules to adapt your armor to different combat situations and playstyles.
Features
Modular armor made of multiple equipment parts. Installable upgrades to customize your gear. Separate energy storage for the chest armor and helmet. Energy-powered systems, including a protective shield. XML-configurable modules for players who want to create their own variants.
The mod is currently in development. Features and balance may change in future updates.
Game version: RimWorld 1.6
Compatibility: More information coming soon.
Development note: This mod was created with approximately 80% assistance from GPT-6.1 Sol, with additional help from GPT-6 Luna and DeepSeek.
